result.title: DiRAFT: Privacy-Aware Financial Transcript Synthesis from Aggregate Discourse Priors
result.comment: 21 pages. Accepted at the Financial AI Security, Privacy and Safety Workshop at ICAIF 2026 (non-archival)
result.summary: Using customer conversations to train and evaluate financial language models raises confidentiality concerns because non-public financial facts can remain after direct identifiers are masked. Synthetic transcripts offer an alternative data source, but their discourse fidelity and residual confidentiality risks require assessment. We introduce DiRAFT (Discourse Realization from Aggregate First-order Transitions), which extracts financial concept graphs and records the order in which concepts are first introduced. It pools adjacent concept transitions across training records and samples new graph plans from aggregate transition, starting-concept, and plan-length priors. A discourse layer guides text realization without supplying an individual source passage or graph. We assess privacy-related risks through two complementary evaluations: corpus-level structural overlap and source-grounded checks for specific non-public investor facts. The structural assessment covers two financial corpora and three generation backends. The confidential-fact assessment uses human review of 1,400 investor-call outputs across seven strategies and two backends. We also evaluate transition fidelity, content recoverability, and trajectory diversity. Stochastic sampling provides a favorable balance between transition fidelity and structural overlap, with consistent advantages over greedy and top-3 on investor calls. The confidential-fact assessment likewise detects fewer matches for stochastic sampling than these alternatives on both backends covered by the fact assessment. These complementary assessments provide empirical evidence on residual confidentiality risks without establishing a formal guarantee.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DiRAFT，用聚合的概念转移、起始概念与计划长度先验采样新的概念图计划，再由话语层生成金融电话会合成文本，并从语料结构重叠与人工核查非公开事实残留两方面评估隐私风险。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作聚焦合成金融文本的隐私与结构保真评估，不涉及 VLM 推理中的视觉状态表示、latent 内容使用或停止决策，其先验采样与话语实现也难以给出具体可迁移的 LVR 方法线索，故排除。
